entries.title: A part you asked to wait no longer holds up its main task unnoticed
entries.body: When every other part of a main task has finished and the one left is a part you asked to wait, a note now tells you once that the main task waits only on it. Start it from the task board, or reply to the note to change or drop it.

picture.alt: A note says a main task waits only on the one part you asked to wait
